topic: Production phone audit and first alpha hotfix
currentUserGoal: Resume work from the newly launched alpha and harden the first production experience before wider Discord testing.
workCompleted: Audited the production alpha at a 390x844 phone viewport from a fresh production save.
Confirmed and fixed the compact Ancient Grass status panel overlapping the stacked Grass Toucher identity panel.
Added a shorter 174px compact HUD treatment and moved the compact Scourge row upward so all status content remains inside its frame.
Paused active-run simulation while Options is open, preventing HP drain, wound-pressure progress, automation timing, and hidden Game Over transitions during audio adjustment.
Made every dormancy-summary path dismiss Options before showing Memory Grove.
Audited the phone Memory Grove and confirmed its report, zoomable tree, detail panel, and Begin Next Run action remain usable at 390x844.
Updated the durable redesign specification and implementation acceptance notes.
Committed, pushed, and deployed the hotfix to production.
verificationRun: Initial 390x844 production screenshot reproduced the status/player overlap and showed that HP could reach zero behind the open Options modal.
Final npm run check passed: ESLint, 68 Vitest tests across seven files, TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Patched 390x844 localhost screenshot showed a clear gap between the compact status, player, and advisor panels with the Scourge row inside the HUD frame.
Options pause smoke held Ancient HP exactly at 69.66989088682563 for 2500ms, then published the same value after closing.
Internal forced-dormancy smoke opened Options, forced Game Over, and reported Options visible false with Memory Grove active.
Phone Memory Grove screenshot showed the full run report, Memory Tree controls, selected-memory details, guidance, and Begin Next Run action without overlap.
Browser console error check returned no errors.
Vercel production inspection reported Ready and the custom domain returned HTTP 200 with /assets/index-D-rnI6LC.js, matching the local production build.
currentGitStatus: Expected after committing and pushing this handoff: clean master aligned with origin/master.
The production game-code deployment is commit 2ba333c; the later handoff-only commit does not alter the application bundle.
knownIssues: Active-run state still does not persist across refresh; only permanent GT and remembered upgrades are saved.
The phone Field Kit non-overlap is covered by pure placement tests, but a production screenshot after the first multi-root expansion is still outstanding.
The Open Graph preview still represents the previous game and should be replaced before broad Discord sharing.
Vercel deployment ignores are not tuned yet, so manual archive deployments remain unnecessarily large.
At widths below 360px the minimum HUD width is still 360px; the supported first phone audit was 390px.
nextRecommendedSteps: Let the user and first Discord testers play the live hotfix naturally and collect only reproducible alpha blockers.
Replace the Open Graph preview with an Ancient Grass/Scourge alpha card before broad link sharing.
Capture a 390px multi-root Field Kit screenshot after natural first-run expansion.
Decide whether active-run persistence is required for the next alpha checkpoint.
Add a conservative .vercelignore for docs artifacts and machine-local output.
doNotRevert: Keep Options as a true pause for active-run simulation.
Keep Options automatically dismissed before Memory Grove appears.
Keep the compact HUD shorter than the full desktop HUD when compact identity/advisor panels are visible.
Keep the redesign alpha on the production root and the previous game behind ?legacy.
Keep the left vertical numbered Field Kit and 1-7 keyboard controls.
